newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: St George sees further expansion.
newsitem.headline: St George sees further expansion.

text.p: St George Bank Ltd managing director Jim Sweeney said on Friday the bank was still not big enough and there was room for further expansion.
Sweeney told an Institute of Chartered Accountants function that St George had merged with Advance Bank to give it the critical mass to compete with Australia's big four banks.
"I thought that we were too small and I am still not sure that we are big enough," Sweeney said.
St George acquistion of the State Bank of South Australia along with Advance Bank had given the enlarged group the expertise to expand into rural lending.
Sweeney said State Bank of South Australia had over a third of its loan book in rural lending and had developed special technics which could be exported to New South Wales.
"We will be able to play a bigger role in rural lending than other either Advance Bank or St George Bank have been able to play until now," Sweeney said.
St George finalised its A$2.65 billion takeover of fellow Sydney-based bank Advance Bank earlier this year, after four attempts to takeover fellow regional Australia banks.
